caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a young boy with dark skin and short curly black hair, standing barefoot on a square pedestal with a circular raised platform. The boy is dressed in loose, bright blue pants that are tied around the waist and drape down to his ankles, and a white shirt with short sleeves that hangs open at the chest, showing part of his torso. A single red strap runs diagonally from his left shoulder to his right hip. The boy's left hand is by his side, while his right hand is raised, holding a small round object. The figure is positioned facing slightly to the right, and there is a signature in the bottom right corner of the image that reads "Eugene Croe." The background is a plain, off-white color with no additional objects or scenery.
title: Cast Iron Hitching Post
